bookInfo.author: Xue Juzheng et al.

title.zh: 卷一百二十 周書11: 恭帝本紀
title.en: Volume 120 Book of Later Zhou 22: Emperor Gong Annals
title.raw: 卷一百二十 周書11: 恭帝本紀 Volume 120 Book of Later Zhou 22: Emperor Gong Annals

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，以戶部尚書李濤為山陵副使，以度支郎中盧億為山陵判官。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingwei, Li Tao, Minister of Revenue, was appointed deputy commissioner for the imperial tomb, and Lu Yi, bureau director of expenditures, was appointed judge for the imperial tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the seventh month of autumn, Li Tao, Minister of Revenue, was made deputy commissioner for the imperial tomb and Lu Yi, bureau director of expenditures, judge for the tomb.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，左散騎常侍申文炳卒。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Shen Wenbing, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Shen Wenbing, Left Regular Attendant of the Cavalry, died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，右拾遺徐雄奪三任官，坐誣奏雷澤縣令虛破戶也。

translations.literal: On yimao, Remonstrance Censor Xu Xiong was stripped of three ranks of office for falsely memorializing that the magistrate of Leize County had fraudulently reduced registered households.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Xu Xiong, Remonstrance Censor of the Right, was stripped of three ranks for falsely accusing the magistrate of Leize of inflating household destruction figures.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，百僚釋服。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the hundred officials laid aside mourning dress.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the officials ended their mourning dress.

sentences.zh: 尚輦奉御金彥英，本高麗人也，奉使高麗，稱臣於其王，故及於罪。

translations.literal: Jin Yanying, Attendant of the Imperial Carriage, was originally a man of Goryeo; on a mission to Goryeo he declared himself subject to its king, and therefore incurred guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Yanying of the Imperial Carriage, a native of Goryeo, was punished because on a mission home he had prostrated himself as subject to the Goryeo king.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以邢州節度使王仁鎬為襄州節度使，進封開國公；

translations.literal: On gengshen, Xingzhou military commissioner Wang Renhao was made Xiangzhou military commissioner and advanced to Duke Who Opens the State;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Renhao of Xingzhou became Xiangzhou commissioner and was made Duke Who Opens the State;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、曹州節度使、檢校太保袁彥為陜州節度使、加檢校太傅；

translations.literal: Yuan Yan, Director-in-Chief of the Palace Foot Guards, Caozhou military commissioner, and acting Grand Guardian, was made Shanzhou military commissioner and given acting Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Yan, director of the Palace Foot Guards and Caozhou commissioner, became Shanzhou commissioner with the added rank of acting Grand Tutor;

sentences.zh: 以右羽林統軍、權知邢州事、檢校太保李繼勛為邢州節度使，加檢校太傅；

translations.literal: Li Jixun, Commander of the Right Forest of Cavalry, acting Xingzhou administrator, and acting Grand Guardian, was made Xingzhou military commissioner and given acting Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Li Jixun, commander of the Right Forest Cavalry and acting Xingzhou administrator, became Xingzhou commissioner with acting Grand Tutor;

sentences.zh: 以滑州留後、檢校太保陳思讓為滄州節度使；

translations.literal: Chen Sirang, acting Huazhou administrator and acting Grand Guardian, was made Cangzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Sirang, acting Huazhou administrator, became Cangzhou commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、陳州節度使、檢校太傅韓令坤為侍衛馬步都虞候，依前陳州節度使，加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: Han Lingkun, Director-in-Chief of the Palace Horse Guards, Chenzhou military commissioner, and acting Grand Tutor, was made Deputy Director-in-Chief of the Palace Horse and Foot Guards, remaining Chenzhou military commissioner, and given acting Grand Marshal;
translations.idiomatic: Han Lingkun, director of the Palace Horse Guards and Chenzhou commissioner, became deputy director of the Palace Horse and Foot Guards, kept Chenzhou, and was given acting Grand Marshal;

sentences.zh: 以虎捷左廂都指揮使、岳州防禦使、檢校司徒高懷德為夔州節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使、檢校太保；

translations.literal: Gao Huaide, Commander of the Left Wing of the Tiger Swift Guards, Yuezhou defense commissioner, and acting Minister of Education, was made Kuizhou military commissioner, filling the post of Director-in-Chief of the Palace Horse Guards and acting Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huaide of the Tiger Swift Left Wing and Yuezhou became Kuizhou commissioner and director of the Palace Horse Guards with acting Grand Guardian;

sentences.zh: 以虎捷左廂都指揮使、常州防禦使、檢校司空張鐸為遂州節度使，充侍衛步軍都指揮使、檢校太保，仍改名令鐸。

translations.literal: Zhang Duo, Commander of the Left Wing of the Tiger Swift Guards, Changzhou defense commissioner, and acting Minister of Works, was made Suizhou military commissioner, filling the post of Director-in-Chief of the Palace Foot Guards and acting Grand Guardian, and was further renamed Lingduo.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Duo of the Tiger Swift Left Wing and Changzhou became Suizhou commissioner and director of the Palace Foot Guards with acting Grand Guardian, and was renamed Lingduo.

sentences.zh: （《宋史·張令鐸傳》云：本名鐸，以與河中張鐸同姓名，故賜今名。）〉

translations.literal: (The Biography of Zhang Lingduo in the History of Song states: his original name was Duo; because it was the same as Zhang Duo of Hezhong, he was granted his present name.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (History of Song, Biography of Zhang Lingduo: his original name was Duo; because Zhang Duo of Hezhong shared the name, he was granted Lingduo.)〉

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以鄆州節度使、充侍衛馬步軍都指揮使、檢校太傅、兼侍中李重進為淮南節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中，依前侍衛馬步軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: On renxu, Li Chongjin, Yanzhou military commissioner, Director-in-Chief of the Palace Horse and Foot Guards, acting Grand Tutor, and Concurrent Palace Attendant, was made Huainan military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, and Concurrent Palace Attendant, remaining Director-in-Chief of the Palace Horse and Foot Guards;
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Chongjin of Yanzhou, director of the Palace Horse and Foot Guards, became Huainan commissioner with acting Grand Marshal and Palace Attendant, keeping his guard command;

sentences.zh: 以襄州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事向拱為河南尹，充西京留守，加檢校太師、兼侍中；

translations.literal: Xiang Gong, Xiangzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, and Concurrent Grand Councilor, was made Intendant of Henan, filling the post of Western Capital regent, and given acting Grand Preceptor and Concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Xiang Gong of Xiangzhou, acting Grand Marshal and grand councilor, became Intendant of Henan and Western Capital regent with acting Grand Preceptor and Palace Attendant;

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：向拱即向訓也，避恭帝名改焉。）〉

translations.literal: (Comprehensive Mirror: Xiang Gong is Xiang Xun, renamed to avoid the taboo name of Emperor Gong.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Comprehensive Mirror: Xiang Gong was Xiang Xun, renamed to avoid Emperor Gong's taboo.)〉

sentences.zh: 以宋州節度使、充侍衛馬步軍副都指揮、檢校太尉、同平章事韓通為鄆州節度使，依前侍衛親軍馬步軍副都指揮使；

translations.literal: Han Tong, Songzhou military commissioner, Deputy Director-in-Chief of the Palace Horse and Foot Guards, acting Grand Marshal, and Concurrent Grand Councilor, was made Yanzhou military commissioner, remaining Deputy Director-in-Chief of the Palace Personal Army Horse and Foot Guards;
translations.idiomatic: Han Tong of Songzhou, deputy director of the Palace Horse and Foot Guards, became Yanzhou commissioner while keeping his deputy guard command;

sentences.zh: 以澶州節度使、檢校太尉、同平章事、附馬都尉張永德為許州節度使，進封開國公；

translations.literal: Zhang Yongde, Caozhou military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Imperial Son-in-Law, was made Xuzhou military commissioner and advanced to Duke Who Opens the State;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yongde of Caozhou, imperial son-in-law and grand councilor, became Xuzhou commissioner and was made Duke Who Opens the State;

sentences.zh: 以今上為宋州節度使，依前檢校太尉、殿前都點檢，進封開國侯；

translations.literal: The Present Lord was made Songzhou military commissioner, remaining acting Grand Marshal and Director of the Palace Front, and advanced to Marquis Who Opens the State;
translations.idiomatic: The present sovereign was made Songzhou commissioner, kept acting Grand Marshal and Director of the Palace Front, and was advanced to Marquis Who Opens the State;

sentences.zh: 以淮南節度使兼殿前副都點檢、檢校太保慕容延釗為澶州節度使、檢校太傅，依前殿前副都點檢，進封開國伯；

translations.literal: Murong Yanzhao, Huainan military commissioner, Concurrent Deputy Director of the Palace Front, and acting Grand Guardian, was made Caozhou military commissioner and acting Grand Tutor, remaining Deputy Director of the Palace Front, and advanced to Earl Who Opens the State;
translations.idiomatic: Murong Yanzhao of Huainan, deputy director of the Palace Front, became Caozhou commissioner with acting Grand Tutor, kept his front-director post, and was made Earl Who Opens the State;

sentences.zh: 以殿前都指揮使、江州防禦使、檢校司空石守信為滑州節度使、檢校太保，依前殿前都指揮使。

translations.literal: Shi Shouxin, Director-in-Chief of the Palace Front, Jiangzhou defense commissioner, and acting Minister of Works, was made Huazhou military commissioner and acting Grand Guardian, remaining Director-in-Chief of the Palace Front.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Shouxin, director of the Palace Front and Jiangzhou defense commissioner, became Huazhou commissioner with acting Grand Guardian while keeping command of the Palace Front.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，制大赦天下。

translations.literal: On bingyin, an edict proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin a great amnesty was proclaimed for the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚午，翰林學士、判太常寺竇儼撰進大行皇帝太室歌酌獻辭，舞曰《定功之舞》，歌辭不錄。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Dou Yan, Hanlin Academician and overseer of the Directorate of Ceremonies, drafted and presented the libation text for offering to the Grand Chamber of the late emperor, with the dance titled Dance of Establishing Merit; the song text is not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Dou Yan, Hanlin academician and overseer of the Directorate of Ceremonies, presented the libation hymn for the late emperor's Grand Chamber offering, with the dance Establishing Merit; the lyrics are not recorded.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸道相繼奏，大雨，所在川渠漲溢，漂溺廬舍，損害苗稼。

translations.literal: That month, the various circuits reported in succession that heavy rain had caused rivers and canals everywhere to swell and overflow, drowning dwellings, and harming the grain in the fields.
translations.idiomatic: That month circuits reported in turn that heavy rains had swollen rivers and canals everywhere, flooding homes and damaging crops.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌朔，以光祿卿致仕柴守禮為太子太保致仕。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day jiaxu, Chai Shouli, retired Director of the Imperial Household, was made retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiaxu of the eighth month, Chai Shouli, retired Director of the Imperial Household, was made retired Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，翰林學士兼判太常寺竇儼撰進大行皇帝尊謚曰睿武孝文皇帝，廟號世宗，從之。

translations.literal: On yihai, Dou Yan, Hanlin Academician and Concurrent overseer of the Directorate of Ceremonies, drafted and presented the honorific posthumous title of the late emperor as Sagacious Martial Filial Cultured Emperor, with temple name Shizong; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Dou Yan presented the late emperor's posthumous title Sagacious Martial Filial Cultured Emperor and temple name Shizong; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，天下兵馬都元帥、守尚書令、兼中書令、吳越國王錢俶加食邑一千戶，實封四百戶，改賜功臣；

translations.literal: On gengchen, Qian Chu, Commander-in-Chief of All Armies and Horses under Heaven, Defender of the Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Secretariat Director, and King of Wuyue, was given an additional thousand households in his fief income and four hundred households in actual enfeoffment, and was granted a new designation of meritorious subject;
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Qian Chu of Wuyue, commander-in-chief of all armies, received an added thousand fief households and four hundred enfeoffed households and a new meritorious-subject designation;

sentences.zh: 天雄軍節度使、檢校太師、守太傅、兼中書令、魏王符彥卿加守太尉；

translations.literal: Fu Yanqing, Tianxiong Army military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Defender of Grand Tutor, Concurrent Secretariat Director, and Prince of Wei, was given Defender of Grand Marshal;
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanqing of Tianxiong, Prince of Wei, was advanced to Defender of Grand Marshal;

sentences.zh: 夏州節度使、檢校太師、守太保、兼中書令、西平王李彜興加守太傅；

translations.literal: Li Yixing, Xiazhou military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Defender of Grand Guardian, Concurrent Secretariat Director, and Prince of Xiping, was given Defender of Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Li Yixing of Xiazhou, Prince of Xiping, was advanced to Defender of Grand Tutor;

sentences.zh: 荊南節度使、檢校太師、守中書令、南平王高保融加守太保。

translations.literal: Gao Baorong, Jingnan military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Defender of Secretariat Director, and Prince of Nanping, was given Defender of Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Baorong of Jingnan, Prince of Nanping, was advanced to Defender of Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 壬午，山陵使範質撰進大行皇帝陵名曰慶陵，從之。

translations.literal: On renwu, Fan Zhi, commissioner for the imperial tomb, drafted and presented the name of the late emperor's tomb as Qingling; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Fan Zhi, tomb commissioner, proposed Qingling as the late emperor's tomb name; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 秦州節度使、西面沿邊都部署、檢校太師、守中書令、褒國公王景進封涼國公，徐州節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令郭從義加開府儀同三司，鄜州節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、邢國公武行德進封宋國公，永興軍節度使、檢校太師、兼侍中李洪義加開府儀同三司，鳳翔節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中郭崇加檢校太師，潞州節度使、檢校太傅、兼侍中李筠加檢校太尉，朗州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中周行逢加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Wang Jing, Qinzhou military commissioner, Western Frontier Commander-in-Chief, acting Grand Preceptor, Defender of Secretariat Director, and Duke of Bao, was advanced to Duke of Liang; Guo Congyi, Xuzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, and Concurrent Secretariat Director, was given Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; Wu Xingde, Fuzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Secretariat Director, and Duke of Xing, was advanced to Duke of Song; Li Hongyi, Yongxing Army military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, and Concurrent Palace Attendant, was given Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; Guo Chong, Fengxiang military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, and Concurrent Palace Attendant, was given acting Grand Preceptor; Li Jun, Luzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, and Concurrent Palace Attendant, was given acting Grand Marshal; Zhou Xingfeng, Langzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Marshal, and Concurrent Palace Attendant, was given acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jing of Qinzhou, Duke of Bao, was made Duke of Liang; Guo Congyi of Xuzhou received Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon; Wu Xingde of Fuzhou, Duke of Xing, was made Duke of Song; Li Hongyi of Yongxing Army received the same grand-master honor; Guo Chong of Fengxiang was advanced to acting Grand Preceptor; Li Jun of Luzhou to acting Grand Marshal; and Zhou Xingfeng of Langzhou to acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，壽州節度使、檢校太師、同平章事、韓國公楊信封魯國公；

translations.literal: On jiashen, Yang Xin, Shouzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Duke of Han, was enfeoffed as Duke of Lu;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Yang Xin of Shouzhou, Duke of Han, was made Duke of Lu;

sentences.zh: 邠州節度使、檢校太師劉重進，廬州節度使、檢校太尉趙贊，鄧州節度使、檢校太尉宋延渥，並加開府儀同三司；

translations.literal: Liu Chongjin, Binzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Preceptor; Zhao Zan, Luzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Marshal; and Song Yanwo, Dengzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Marshal, were all given Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon;
translations.idiomatic: Liu Chongjin of Binzhou, Zhao Zan of Luzhou, and Song Yanwo of Dengzhou all received Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon;

sentences.zh: 涇州節度使、檢校太尉白重贊，河中節度使、檢校太尉張鐸，並加階爵。

translations.literal: Bai Chongzan, Jingzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Marshal, and Zhang Duo, Hezhong military commissioner and acting Grand Marshal, were both given higher noble ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Chongzan of Jingzhou and Zhang Duo of Hezhong were both advanced in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，易定節度使孫行友、靈州節度使馮繼業、府州節度使折德扆，並自檢校太保加檢校太傅，進階爵。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Sun Xingyou, Yiding military commissioner; Feng Jiye, Lingzhou military commissioner; and Zhe Deyi, Fuzhou military commissioner, were all advanced from acting Grand Guardian to acting Grand Tutor and given higher noble ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Sun Xingyou of Yiding, Feng Jiye of Lingzhou, and Zhe Deyi of Fuzhou were all advanced from acting Grand Guardian to acting Grand Tutor and raised in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 以延州留後、檢校太傅李萬全為延州節度使，進封開國公。

translations.literal: Li Wanquan, acting Yanzhou administrator and acting Grand Tutor, was made Yanzhou military commissioner and advanced to Duke Who Opens the State.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wanquan, acting Yanzhou administrator, became Yanzhou commissioner and was made Duke Who Opens the State.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，皇弟特進檢校太保、左驍衛上將軍、燕國公、食邑三千戶宗讓加檢校太傅，進封曹王，改名熙讓；

translations.literal: On gengyin, the imperial younger brother Zongrang, specially advanced, acting Grand Guardian, General-in-Chief of the Left Valiant Cavalry Guards, Duke of Yan, with a fief income of three thousand households, was given acting Grand Tutor, advanced to Prince of Cao, and renamed Xirang;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor's younger brother Zongrang, Duke of Yan with three thousand fief households, was given acting Grand Tutor, made Prince of Cao, and renamed Xirang;

sentences.zh: 熙謹拜光祿大夫、檢校太保、右武衛大將軍，封紀王，食邑三千戶；

translations.literal: Xijin was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting Grand Guardian, and Great General of the Right Martial Guards, enfeoffed as Prince of Ji with a fief income of three thousand households;
translations.idiomatic: Xijin was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and acting Grand Guardian, made great general of the Right Martial Guards and Prince of Ji with three thousand fief households;

sentences.zh: 皇弟熙誨拜金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒、左領衛大將軍，封蘄王，食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: The imperial younger brother Xihui was appointed Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, acting Minister of Education, and Great General of the Left Leading Guards, enfeoffed as Prince of Qi with a fief income of three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's younger brother Xihui was appointed Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and acting Minister of Education, made great general of the Left Leading Guards and Prince of Qi with three thousand fief households.

sentences.zh: 制下，即令所司擇日備禮冊命。

translations.literal: When the edict was issued, the relevant offices were at once ordered to choose a day and prepare the rites of investiture.
translations.idiomatic: Once the edict was issued, the relevant offices were ordered at once to choose a day and prepare the investiture rites.

sentences.zh: 以晉國長公主張氏為晉國大長公主；

translations.literal: Lady Zhang, Princess of Jin, was made Grand Princess of Jin;
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhang, Princess of Jin, was advanced to Grand Princess of Jin;

sentences.zh: 以前陜州節度使、檢校太尉藥元福為曹州節度使，進階爵。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanfu, former Shanzhou military commissioner and acting Grand Marshal, was made Caozhou military commissioner and given a higher noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanfu, former Shanzhou commissioner, became Caozhou commissioner and was advanced in noble rank.

sentences.zh: 甲午，守司徒、同平章事、宏文館大學士、參知樞密院事範質加開府儀同三司，進封蕭國公；

translations.literal: On jiawu, Fan Zhi, Defender of Minister of Education, Concurrent Grand Councilor, Grand Academician of the Hongwen Hall, and Participant in the Bureau of Military Affairs, was given Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and advanced to Duke of Xiao;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Fan Zhi, grand councilor and participant in military affairs, received Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and was made Duke of Xiao;

sentences.zh: 門下侍郎兼禮部尚書、同平章事、監修國史、參知樞密院事王溥加右僕射，進封開國公；

translations.literal: Wang Pu, Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Minister of Rites, Concurrent Grand Councilor, overseer of the compilation of the National History, and Participant in the Bureau of Military Affairs, was given Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and advanced to Duke Who Opens the State;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Pu, vice director of the Secretariat and grand councilor, was made right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and Duke Who Opens the State;

sentences.zh: 樞密使、中書侍郎、同平章事、集賢殿大學士魏仁浦加兼刑部尚書，依前樞密使；

translations.literal: Wei Renpu, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, Vice Director of the Central Secretariat, Concurrent Grand Councilor, and Grand Academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, was given Concurrent Minister of Justice, remaining Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Wei Renpu, military-affairs commissioner and grand councilor, was given concurrent Minister of Justice while keeping his military-affairs post;

sentences.zh: 檢校太傅、右驍衛上將軍吳延祚依前樞密使，進封慶國公；

translations.literal: Wu Yanzuo, acting Grand Tutor and General-in-Chief of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guards, remained Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs and was advanced to Duke of Qing;
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yanzuo, acting Grand Tutor and general of the Right Valiant Cavalry Guards, kept his military-affairs commission and was made Duke of Qing;

sentences.zh: 以左武衛上將軍史牷為左金吾上將軍致仕。

translations.literal: Shi Quan, General-in-Chief of the Left Martial Guards, was made retired General-in-Chief of the Left Golden Crow Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Quan, general of the Left Martial Guards, was retired as general of the Left Golden Crow Guards.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以隴州防禦使王全斌為相州留後。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Wang Quanbin, Longzhou defense commissioner, was made acting Xiangzhou administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Wang Quanbin of Longzhou was made acting Xiangzhou administrator.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，宣徽南院使、判開封府事昝居潤，宣徽北院使、判三司張美，並加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Zan Jurun, Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and overseer of Kaifeng Prefecture affairs, and Zhang Mei, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and overseer of the Three Offices, were both given acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zan Jurun of the Southern Palace Secretariat and Zhang Mei of the Northern Palace Secretariat were both given acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 己亥，前司空李穀加開府儀同三司、趙國公，以前太傅、少卿朱渭為太僕卿致仕。

translations.literal: On jihai, Li Gu, former Minister of Works, was given Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and made Duke of Zhao; Zhu Wei, former Grand Tutor and vice director, was made retired Director of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Li Gu, former Minister of Works, received Grand Master with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and was made Duke of Zhao; Zhu Wei, former grand tutor and vice director, was retired as Director of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，左金吾上將軍致仕史牷卒。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Shi Quan, retired General-in-Chief of the Left Golden Crow Guards, died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Shi Quan, retired general of the Left Golden Crow Guards, died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，高麗國遣使朝貢，兼進《別序孝經》一卷、《越王孝經新義》一卷、《皇靈孝經》一卷、《孝經雌圖》三卷。

translations.literal: On renyin, Goryeo sent envoys to offer tribute and also presented one scroll of the Classic of Filial Piety with a Separate Preface, one scroll of the New Meaning of the Classic of Filial Piety of the King of Yue, one scroll of the Imperial Spirit Classic of Filial Piety, and three scrolls of the Yin Diagram of the Classic of Filial Piety.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Goryeo sent tribute envoys who also presented one scroll each of Separate Preface to the Classic of Filial Piety, New Meaning of the Yue King's Classic of Filial Piety, and Imperial Spirit Classic of Filial Piety, and three scrolls of the Yin Diagram of the Classic of Filial Piety.

sentences.zh: （《文昌雜錄》云：《別序》者，記孔子所生及弟子從學之事。

translations.literal: (Miscellaneous Records from Wenchang states: Separate Preface records where Confucius was born and matters of disciples following him in study.
translations.idiomatic: (Miscellaneous Records from Wenchang: Separate Preface records Confucius's birthplace and his disciples' studies.

sentences.zh: 《新義》者，以越王為問目，釋疏文之義。

translations.literal: New Meaning takes the King of Yue as the questioner and explains the meaning of the commentary text.
translations.idiomatic: New Meaning uses the King of Yue as interlocutor to explain the commentary.

sentences.zh: 《皇靈》者，止說延年避災之事及符文，乃道書也。

translations.literal: Imperial Spirit speaks only of prolonging life and avoiding calamity and of talismanic writings—it is a Daoist book.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial Spirit deals only with prolonging life, avoiding disaster, and talismanic writings—it is a Daoist text.

sentences.zh: 《雌圖》者，止說日之環暈、星之彗孛，亦非奇書。）〉

translations.literal: Yin Diagram speaks only of solar halos and comets and broom-stars—it too is no remarkable book.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Yin Diagram discusses only solar halos and comets—hardly a remarkable book either.)〉

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，前滄州留後李彥頵卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renzi, Li Yanwen, former acting Cangzhou administrator, died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the ninth month Li Yanwen, former acting Cangzhou administrator, died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，高麗王王昭加檢校太師，食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: On yimao, Wang Zhao, King of Goryeo, was given acting Grand Preceptor and a fief income of three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Wang Zhao of Goryeo was given acting Grand Preceptor and three thousand fief households.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以三司副使王贊為內客省使兼北面諸州水陸轉運使。

translations.literal: Wang Zan, vice commissioner of the Three Offices, was made Commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau and Concurrent Commissioner for Water and Land Transport of the Northern Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zan, vice commissioner of the Three Offices, became commissioner of the Inner Guests Bureau and concurrent northern transport commissioner for water and land routes.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，前開封縣令路延規除名，流沙門島。

translations.literal: On guihai, Lu Yankui, former magistrate of Kaifeng County, was struck from the rolls and exiled to Shamen Island.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Lu Yankui, former magistrate of Kaifeng County, was struck from office and exiled to Shamen Island.

sentences.zh: 先是，延規有過停任，有司召延規宣敕，延規拒命，為憲司所按，故有是命。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yankui had been suspended for an offense; when the relevant offices summoned him to receive the edict, he refused the order and was investigated by the censorate, hence this command.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yankui had been suspended for misconduct; when summoned to receive an edict he refused, was investigated by the censorate, and received this sentence.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以端明殿學士、禮部侍郎竇儀為兵部侍郎充職；

translations.literal: On jiazi, Dou Yi, academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity and Vice Minister of Rites, was made Vice Minister of War to fill the post;
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Dou Yi, academician of the Hall of Brilliant Clarity and vice minister of rites, became vice minister of war;

sentences.zh: 以尚書戶部員外郎、直樞密院杜華為司門郎中，充樞密直學士，賜紫；

translations.literal: Du Hua, Secretariat Bureau Director of the Households Section and attached to the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Bureau Director of the Gate Section, filling the post of direct academician of the Bureau of Military Affairs, and was granted purple;
translations.idiomatic: Du Hua, attached to the Bureau of Military Affairs, became bureau director of the Gate Section and direct military-affairs academician, and was granted purple robes;

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、尚書度支員外郎王著為金部郎中、知制誥充職，仍賜金紫。

translations.literal: Wang Zhu, Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Bureau Director of the Expenditures Section, was made Bureau Director of the Metals Section and Drafter of Imperial Commands to fill the post, and was further granted gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhu, Hanlin academician and expenditures bureau director, became metals bureau director and drafter of imperial commands, and was granted gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 是日，翰林學士、尚書屯田郎中、知制誥李昉，都官郎中、知制誥扈蒙，水部郎中、知制誥趙逢，並加柱國，賜金紫。

translations.literal: That day, Li Fang, Hanlin Academician, Secretariat Bureau Director of the Fields Section, and Drafter of Imperial Commands; Humeng, Bureau Director of the Capital Section and Drafter of Imperial Commands; and Zhao Feng, Bureau Director of the Waters Section and Drafter of Imperial Commands, were all given Pillar of the State and granted gold and purple.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Li Fang, Humeng, and Zhao Feng, all drafters of imperial commands, were given Pillar of the State and granted gold and purple.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，兵部尚書張昭進封舒國公，戶部尚書李濤進封莒國公。

translations.literal: On yichou, Zhang Zhao, Minister of War, was advanced to Duke of Shu, and Li Tao, Minister of Revenue, was advanced to Duke of Ju.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhang Zhao, Minister of War, was made Duke of Shu, and Li Tao, Minister of Revenue, Duke of Ju.

sentences.zh: 以太子詹事劉溫叟為工部侍郎，判國子祭酒事。

translations.literal: Liu Wensou, Household Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Vice Minister of Works and overseer of the Directorate of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wensou, mentor of the heir apparent, became vice minister of works and overseer of the National University.

sentences.zh: 是月，京師及諸州郡霖雨逾旬，所在水潦為患，川渠泛溢。

translations.literal: That month, in the capital and the various prefectures and commanderies rain fell for more than ten days; flooding was a calamity everywhere, and rivers and canals overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That month rain in the capital and prefectures lasted more than ten days, flooding everywhere and swelling rivers and canals.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，以司農卿致仕李鍇為太僕卿致仕，太常少卿致仕姚遂為將作監致仕。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the first day guiyou, Li Kai, retired Director of Agriculture, was made retired Director of the Imperial Stud, and Yao Sui, retired Vice Director of Ceremonies, was made retired Director of Palace Construction.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day guiyou of the tenth winter month, Li Kai, retired director of agriculture, was made retired director of the imperial stud, and Yao Sui, retired vice director of ceremonies, retired director of palace construction.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太子太師薛懷讓封杞國公。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Xue Huairang, Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, was enfeoffed as Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Xue Huairang, grand preceptor of the heir apparent, was made Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，翰林學士、判太常寺事竇儼撰進貞惠皇后廟歌辭。

translations.literal: On renchen, Dou Yan, Hanlin Academician and overseer of the Directorate of Ceremonies, drafted and presented the temple hymn text for Empress Zhenhui.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Dou Yan, Hanlin academician and overseer of ceremonies, presented the temple hymn for Empress Zhenhui.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，世宗皇帝靈駕發引。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the imperial coffin of Emperor Shizong set out on the funeral procession.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Emperor Shizong's coffin set out on the funeral procession.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以前相州留後王暉為右神武統軍。

translations.literal: Wang Hui, former acting Xiangzhou administrator, was made Commander of the Right Divine Martial Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hui, former acting Xiangzhou administrator, became commander of the Right Divine Martial Guards.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，江南國主李景來告，世子宏冀卒，遣禦廚使張延範充吊祭使。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Li Jing, lord of Jiangnan, came to report that the heir Hongji had died; Zhang Yanfan, commissioner of the Imperial Kitchen, was sent as condolence envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Li Jing of Jiangnan reported the death of his heir Hongji; Zhang Yanfan of the Imperial Kitchen was sent as condolence envoy.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅朔，葬世宗皇帝於慶陵，以貞惠皇后劉氏祔焉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day renyin, Emperor Shizong was buried at Qingling, with Empress Zhenhui, Lady Liu, joined in burial.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renyin of the eleventh month Emperor Shizong was buried at Qingling, with Empress Zhenhui, Lady Liu, interred beside him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，西京奏，太子太師致仕白文珂卒。

translations.literal: On wushen, the Western Capital reported that Bai Wenke, retired Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Western Capital reported the death of Bai Wenke, retired grand preceptor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，日南至，百僚奉表稱賀。

translations.literal: On bingchen, at the winter solstice, the hundred officials presented memorials of congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, the winter solstice, the officials presented congratulatory memorials.

sentences.zh: 戊午，廢兗州廣利軍，依舊為萊蕪監。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the Guangli Army of Yanzhou was abolished and restored as the Laiwu Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Guangli Army of Yanzhou was abolished and restored to the Laowu directorate.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，升鳳州固鎮為雄勝軍。

translations.literal: On renxu, Guzhen in Fengzhou was elevated to the Xiongsheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Guzhen in Fengzhou was elevated to the Xiongsheng Army command.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，左羽林統軍馬希崇。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Ma Xichong, Commander of the Left Forest of Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Ma Xichong, commander of the Left Forest Cavalry.

sentences.zh: （案：此下有脫誤。）〉

translations.literal: (Note: there is a lacuna below.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Note: text is missing below.)〉

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申朔，史館奏，請差官修撰世宗實錄，從之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the first day renshen, the Historiography Office memorialized requesting that officials be assigned to compile the Veritable Records of Shizong; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renshen of the twelfth month the Historiography Office asked that officials be assigned to compile Shizong's Veritable Records; the court approved.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，改萬歲殿為紫宸殿。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the Hall of Ten Thousand Years was renamed the Hall of Purple Serenity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Hall of Ten Thousand Years was renamed the Hall of Purple Serenity.

sentences.zh: 甲午，西京奏，左屯衛上將軍致仕李萼卒。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the Western Capital reported that Li E, retired General-in-Chief of the Left Garrison Guards, had died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Western Capital reported the death of Li E, retired general of the Left Garrison Guards.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大霖，晝昏，凡四日而止，分命使臣賑給諸州遭水人戶。

translations.literal: On yiwei, heavy rain fell; day turned to dusk for four days before it stopped, and envoys were dispatched in turn to provide relief to households afflicted by flooding in the various prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei torrential rain darkened the day for four days; envoys were then sent to relieve flood-stricken households across the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 顯德七年春正月辛丑朔，文武百僚進名奉賀。

translations.literal: In spring of the seventh year of Xiande, on the first day xinchou of the first month, civil and military officials presented their names in congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day xinchou in spring of Xiande 7, civil and military officials offered New Year congratulations.

sentences.zh: 鎮、定二州馳奏，契丹入寇，河東賊軍自土門東下與蕃寇合勢。

translations.literal: Zhen and Ding prefectures sent urgent reports that the Khitan had invaded, and rebel forces of Hedong had come down east from Tumen Pass and joined strength with the barbarian invaders.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen and Ding sent urgent reports that Khitan forces had invaded and Hedong rebels had marched east through Tumen Pass to join them.

sentences.zh: 詔今上率兵北征。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Present Lord to lead troops on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered the present sovereign to lead a northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，發京師，是夕宿於陳橋驛。

translations.literal: On guimao, he set out from the capital; that evening he lodged at Chenqiao Post.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he left the capital and lodged that night at Chenqiao Post.

sentences.zh: 未曙，軍變，將士大噪呼萬歲，擐甲將刃，推戴今上升大位，扶策升馬，擁迫南行。

translations.literal: Before dawn the army mutinied; officers and soldiers raised a great clamor shouting "Ten thousand years!", donned armor and drew blades, and pressed the Present Lord to ascend the great throne; they helped him mount his horse and crowded him southward.
translations.idiomatic: Before dawn the army mutinied; troops shouted "Long live the emperor!", donned armor and drew swords, and pressed the present sovereign onto the throne; they helped him mount and crowded him south.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔曰：「天生蒸民，樹之司牧，二帝推公而禪位，三王乘時以革命，其極一也。

translations.literal: That day an edict said: "Heaven gave birth to the teeming people and set over them rulers and herdsmen; the Two Emperors yielded the public good and abdicated the throne, and the Three Kings seized the time to change the mandate—their ultimate principle is one.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict read: "Heaven bred the people and set rulers over them; Yao and Shun yielded the realm in the public interest, and the Three Kings changed the mandate when the time came—the principle is the same.

sentences.zh: 予末小子，遭家不造，人心已去，國命有歸。

translations.literal: I, an unworthy youth, have met with misfortune in my house; popular hearts have already departed, and the mandate of the state has found its destination.
translations.idiomatic: I am but a young and unworthy ruler; misfortune has struck my house, the people's hearts have turned away, and the mandate has found its new home.

sentences.zh: 咨爾歸德軍節度使、殿前都點檢趙，

translations.literal: I summon you, Zhao, military commissioner of the Guide Army and Director of the Palace Front,
translations.idiomatic: I summon you, Zhao, military commissioner of the Guide Army and director of the Palace Front,

sentences.zh: （案：此下原本空二字。）〉

translations.literal: (Note: the original text here left two characters blank.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Note: the original text here omitted two characters.)〉

sentences.zh: 稟上聖之姿，有神武之略，佐我高祖，格於皇天，逮事世宗，功存納麓，東征西怨，厥績懋焉。

translations.literal: You possess the bearing of the supreme sage and a divinely martial strategy; you aided our High Ancestor and attained the approval of August Heaven; you served Emperor Shizong to the end, your merit preserved in receiving the succession; east and west you campaigned and won hearts—your achievements are abundant.
translations.idiomatic: You bear the stature of a supreme sage and a divinely martial mind; you aided our founding emperor and won Heaven's approval; you served Shizong to the end and secured the succession; your campaigns east and west won the realm—your achievements are great.

sentences.zh: 天地鬼神享於有德，謳謠獄訟附於至仁，應天順民，法堯禪舜，如釋重負，予其作賓，嗚呼欽哉！

translations.literal: Heaven, earth, ghosts, and spirits enjoy offerings from the virtuous; songs of praise and lawsuits of the people attach to supreme benevolence; respond to Heaven and accord with the people, follow Yao in yielding to Shun, as if casting off a heavy burden—I shall be your guest. Alas, reverently!
translations.idiomatic: Heaven, earth, and the spirits accept the offerings of the virtuous; the people's songs and lawsuits turn to supreme benevolence; answer Heaven and follow the people, yield as Yao did to Shun, cast off this heavy burden, and let me be your guest. Reverently!

sentences.zh: 祗畏天命。」

translations.literal: Reverently fear the mandate of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Reverently accept Heaven's mandate.

sentences.zh: 今上於是詣崇元殿受命，百官朝賀而退。

translations.literal: The Present Lord thereupon went to the Hall of Exalted Origin to receive the mandate; the hundred officials offered court congratulations and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The present sovereign then went to the Hall of Exalted Origin to receive the mandate; the officials offered congratulations and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 制封周帝為鄭王，以奉周祀，正朔服色一如舊制，奉皇太后為周太后。

translations.literal: An edict enfeoffed the Zhou emperor as Prince of Zheng to maintain Zhou sacrifices; the calendar, regalia, and colors were to remain as before, and the empress dowager was honored as Zhou Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made the Zhou emperor Prince of Zheng to maintain Zhou rites; calendar, regalia, and colors stayed as before, and the empress dowager was honored as Zhou empress dowager.

sentences.zh: （《續通鑒長編》：建隆三年，周鄭王出居房州。）〉

translations.literal: (Extended Comprehensive Mirror: In the third year of Jianlong, the Zhou Prince of Zheng was sent to reside at Fangzhou.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Extended Comprehensive Mirror: In Jianlong 3 the Zhou Prince of Zheng was sent to live at Fangzhou.)〉

sentences.zh: 皇朝開寶六年春，崩於房陵。

translations.literal: In spring of the sixth year of Kaibao of Our Dynasty, he died at Fangling.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Kaibao 6 he died at Fangling.

sentences.zh: 今上聞之震慟，發哀成服於便殿，百僚進名奉慰，尋遣中使監護其喪。

translations.literal: When the Present Lord heard it he was shaken with grief; he put on mourning dress in the side hall, the hundred officials presented their names in condolence, and soon a palace envoy was sent to oversee the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: The present sovereign was shaken with grief; he donned mourning in the side hall, officials offered condolences, and soon a palace envoy was sent to oversee the funeral.

sentences.zh: （《續通鑒長編》：開寶六年三月乙卯，房州上言，周鄭王殂，上素服發哀，輟視朝十日。）〉

translations.literal: (Extended Comprehensive Mirror: In the third month of the sixth year of Kaibao, on yimao, Fangzhou reported that the Zhou Prince of Zheng had died; the emperor put on plain dress and mourned, suspending court audiences for ten days.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Extended Comprehensive Mirror: On yimao in the third month of Kaibao 6, Fangzhou reported the Zhou Prince of Zheng's death; the emperor wore plain dress, mourned, and suspended court for ten days.)〉

sentences.zh: 以其年十月，歸葬於世宗慶陵之側。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of that year he was returned for burial beside Emperor Shizong's Qingling.
translations.idiomatic: That October he was buried beside Emperor Shizong at Qingling.

sentences.zh: 詔有司定謚曰恭皇帝，陵曰順陵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the relevant offices to fix his posthumous title as Emperor Gong and his tomb as Shunling.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered his posthumous title set as Emperor Gong and his tomb named Shunling.

sentences.zh: （《續通鑒長編》：仁宗嘉祐四年，詔有司取柴氏譜系，於諸房中推最長一人，令歲時奉周祀。）〉

translations.literal: (Extended Comprehensive Mirror: In the fourth year of Jiayou of Emperor Renzong, an edict ordered the relevant offices to take the genealogy of the Chai clan, select the eldest man among the collateral lines, and charge him with maintaining Zhou sacrifices at the proper seasons.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Extended Comprehensive Mirror: In Jiayou 4 of Renzong, the court ordered the Chai genealogy searched and the eldest collateral-line descendant chosen to maintain Zhou sacrifices each year.)〉

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：夫四序之氣，寒往則暑來；

translations.literal: The historiographer says: As for the qi of the four seasons, when cold departs summer arrives;
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer writes: In the cycle of the four seasons, when cold departs, summer comes;

sentences.zh: 五行之數，金銷則火盛。

translations.literal: in the numbers of the Five Phases, when metal wanes fire flourishes.
translations.idiomatic: and in the Five Phases, when metal wanes, fire rises.

sentences.zh: 故堯、舜之揖讓，漢、魏之傳禪，皆知其數而順乎人也。

translations.literal: Therefore the yielding of Yao and Shun and the transmission of the mandate in Han and Wei all knew this number and accorded with human hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Yao and Shun's abdications and the Han and Wei transfers of the mandate all followed this pattern and answered to the people's will.

sentences.zh: 況恭帝當紈綺之沖年，會笙鏞之變響，聽謳歌之所屬，知命歷之有在，能遜其位，不亦善乎。

translations.literal: How much more so when Emperor Gong was in the tender years of silk and brocade, met the changing sound of pipes and bells, heard to whom the songs of praise belonged, knew that the mandate had its place, and was able to yield his throne—is this not good?
translations.idiomatic: All the more so for Emperor Gong, still in tender youth, when the music of state changed key: he heard where the people's songs pointed, knew the mandate had found its holder, and yielded the throne—was that not wise?

sentences.zh: 終謚為恭，固其宜矣。

translations.literal: That his final posthumous title was Gong is indeed fitting.
translations.idiomatic: That his final title was Gong was only fitting.
